description: Implementation of the SymBool class with methods for symbolic boolean operations, conversions, and guards within the c10 namespace.

classes.name: SymBool
classes.description: Represents a symbolic boolean value with methods for logical operations, conversion, and validation within the c10 namespace.

methods.name: toSymNodeImpl
methods.description: Converts SymBool to a SymNode implementation, ensuring heap allocation.

methods.name: wrap_node
methods.description: Wraps a SymNode with the current SymBool context.

methods.name: sym_and
methods.description: Performs logical AND between two SymBool instances.

methods.name: sym_or
methods.description: Performs logical OR between two SymBool instances.

methods.name: sym_not
methods.description: Returns the logical negation of the SymBool.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the SymBool to an ostream.

methods.name: guard_bool
methods.description: Checks if the SymBool is concretely true or false, with file and line info.

methods.name: guard_or_false
methods.description: Checks guard condition, defaults to false.

methods.name: statically_known_true
methods.description: Checks if the SymBool is statically known to be true.

methods.name: guard_or_true
methods.description: Checks guard condition, defaults to true.

methods.name: expect_true
methods.description: Asserts that the SymBool is true.

methods.name: has_hint
methods.description: Checks if the SymBool has a hint.

methods.name: toSymInt
methods.description: Converts SymBool to SymInt, returning 1 or 0 for concrete bools or using symbolic if needed.
